entities.summary: Ante Gotovina, a notable figure in the history of Croatia, associated with EU Integration and Modern Croatia (1998–2013). Preceded by Democratization and ICTY Cooperation. Their legacy influenced Croatia joins the European Union and Croatia adopts the euro and enters the Schengen Area.
